data.summary: The provided Google reviews appear highly authentic with specific details, but the stark contrast with the low Yelp rating (3.3) is concerning and cannot be fully analyzed without Yelp review content. The company has a long, established history and the detailed positive reviews are credible, but the platform discrepancy suggests potential issues with customer satisfaction that may not be visible on Google.
fake_signals: All sampled Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Potential review solicitation from friends/community (mentioned in reviews)
Lack of any negative or mixed reviews in the provided Google sample

positive_evidence: Mention of issues being corrected before customer had to say anything (integrity)

authentic_signals: Extremely specific project details in Google reviews (names, dates, project types)
Varied writing styles and perspectives in Google reviews
Mention of both positive experiences and minor hiccups
Long business history (38 years) and BBB A+ accreditation
complaint_patterns: Potential communication/experience issues with sales (mentioned in one Google review)
Yelp rating suggests possible unresolved customer service problems
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google/Houzz (4.7) and Yelp (3.3). This is a major red flag requiring investigation of Yelp review content, which is not provided in the raw data. The provided Google reviews are all 5-star and highly detailed, which contrasts sharply with the low Yelp rating.

Gary Linder Google Review I highly recommend BMR! I just finished my fourth project with them over the last 20 years and 3 houses. This was a pool and patio extension which turned out beautifully. They are great at keeping you informed of every step in the process and moving things along quickly. Every person was easy to work with. Great team! Cindy Matthews Google Review Fantastic experience with BMR. From design to finished pool, they were a solid company that stands by their word. We had a great project manager (Justin) and a highly engaged team to include personal involvement from company owners. And, they finished on time for our summer pool season. Paul Fitzgerald Google Review My pool was finally finished last week. It seemed like a long time of construction and mud, but in this time of shortages and delivery issues, BMR did get it completed. I am extremely happy with my second BMR pool. Shirley A Google Review My wife and I were extremely impressed with the level of service provided by BMR from the initial meeting with their sales department to the construction phase all the way through punch out the experience has been top notch. Tyler M nailed our design request with a modern spin on a lagoon pool and Mason Thane was great to work with throughout the project as the project manager. I was most impressed with the quality and detail of the stone masons (Jose) on my retaining wall , grotto and outdoor kitchen. Very good experience and high quality result! Matt S. Google Review Just finished our pool and outdoor living with BMR. We couldn’t be more thrilled! It is challenging times right now to build a pool and Mason was great at communicating and keeping the project moving. Given Mason’s experience he offered great suggestions to make our pool design the best. Thank you BMR and Mason!! Elizabeth Hamel Google Review We choose BMR Pool and Patio to design and build this pool and outdoor living area 4 years ago. If you are going to invest in a project of this type, go with one of the best in the area. From the time we walked in to discuss design, right on through project completion BMR was top shelf. reviews.text: Excellent pool contractor! First and foremost, Jason is awesome. He regularly communicates with you and keeps you up to date (even if some aspects of the work are delayed a day or two). I've worked with BMR twice over the past 3 years. The first time I hired them to install a pool and outdoor kitchen (2022). Most recently I had them add a sunshade, inquire about landscaping, and a few minor tweaks to the backyard. The project was on the more difficult side given the smaller space I have in the backyard. I couldn't be happier with the quality of the work. In addition, Stacey (warranty) is incredibly helpful and has assisted with very minor issues that have taken place due to weather events. Chris Benton also gave some of his time to my project and provided some recommendations to the layout. I highly recommend BMR to anyone looking to transfer their backyard space.
reviews.author: Nathan Gibson

reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience working with BMR. Jason (our project manager) and Tyler (our sales consultant) were both fantastic from start to finish.

They truly take care of everything — even coordinating with subcontractors like the fence company, which made the whole process smooth and stress-free. Every time I called, they were available, helpful, and very flexible with all the changes we requested, both during the quoting phase and even in the middle of the project.

They also provided a great 3D model and took the time to explain every detail clearly so we knew exactly what to expect.

Highly recommend BMR, Jason, and Tyler for anyone looking to build a pool!
reviews.author: Alireza Atabaie

reviews.text: We got several different quotes for our in-ground pool installation. BMR’s price was right in line with everybody else. I have to tell you, working with Sam (Samantha, sales), Mason (an owner), Brooks (construction manager), and every single one of their subcontractors was a pleasure. As with any construction project, there were certain hiccups along the way, but they were corrected by either Mason or Brooks before I ever even had a chance to say anything. That’s integrity, and that’s how you run a business. Mason was out here almost as much as Brooks was. When an owner visits the job site, personally sees to it that it's done right, and makes sure you will be happy, what else could you possibly ask for? Don’t even bother getting other quotes. I’m telling you, you can’t go wrong by selecting BMR for your project. If I could give them 10 out of 5 stars, I would. I will definitely be recommending BMR to everyone.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: One of the most reliable, trusted and excellent outdoor builders. We got six things constructed through BMR. Outdoor kitchen, arbor, pool with spa, pool house, extension of our backyard living area and fence. Mason Thane was always reachable whether he was in country or not. They went to the max extent of calling our HOA and explaining the project to get their approval.
reviews.author: Hari Sundar Venkata Ramani

reviews.text:
After getting multiple bids from various companies, we ultimately chose BMR for our pool remodel due to their professionalism, vision, and a personal recommendation from a friend.

They did not disappoint!  We highly recommend this company and would use them again in a heartbeat. BMR did a complete remodel for us- new deck, tile, coping, and plaster. Prior to starting the project, they scheduled a call to handoff from Sales to our Project Manager. Multiple people from the team joined the meeting to ensure everyone was on the same page; very professional.

Our project manager, Greg, was our main point of contact throughout the project; he kept us in the loop and ensured the project went off without a hitch.

We couldn’t be happier with the end result. BMR showed up when they said they would and stood behind their work. Posting multiple pics of the end result and the last pic is the ‘before pic.’
reviews.author: Jen B

reviews.text:
We first learnt about BMR through a couple of our friends in our community. They gave us impressive feedback and we went forward with meeting them for an initial discussion. The initial design phase was fairly quick and they were able to present something very close to what me and my wife wanted. Once we got the initial quote, we got similar quotes from other vendors too, to verify if we going to build the best pool with the best price. BMR was able to explain the technicalities in great detail which we could compare with others. Very soon, we were able to trim down the specs to to fit our budget and were able to get the project underway in a couple of weeks from there.

Around the same time, one of our neighbors also started a pool project with another vendor. The pace at which BMR executed the project was noticeably fast, when we were doing comparisons with our neighbor, with every thing from digging the pool, to laying the plumbing and electrical lines, to laying the concrete, coping and finally the deck, the project went very smoothly with constant updates we received from the project manager over text on a daily basis. Any concerns we raised were almost immediately addressed in no time. They managed to complete the project in a little less than 3 months as promised, including a patio upgrade that they managed to squeeze in.

I would highly recommend BMR for pool and patio projects!
reviews.author: Vasant K Easwaran

reviews.text:
We recently had a project completed by BMR and we are so glad we picked them.

We didn’t start with BMR when seeking designs but one of their competitors that our neighbors had used. When we started feeling uneasy about the pushiness of this competitor we called BMR for a comparison quote. We submitted an online inquiry and quickly got a call back to schedule Tyler M coming out to our house to start the design process. For the record, the previous firm didn’t come out and wanted us to only send them photos. Tyler was excellent with the design requests and changes we wanted. The selection process was easy and smooth and they had plenty of photos of previous constructions we could look at to compare various choices.

After signing the contract everything was smooth sailing with Carlos as our project manager. He made sure to keep us informed of the scheduling updates and responded via text or call almost instantly to any questions we had. There was one update we had to make to the decking midway through the construction and they were very responsive to our changes.

Overall getting our patio extended, kitchen installed, pool & spa done by BMR was very straightforward. We had a project manager change at the end to Ty and even when there was a slight miscommunication, Ty was very apologetic and came out to take care of us promptly.

I would highly recommend BMR and if I ever move and need work done in my backyard I will absolutely use them again.
reviews.author: David Romeo

reviews.text:
We are absolutely thrilled with our new pool, and a huge part of that is thanks to Jose, our project manager. From the moment he took over, the process was smooth and stress-free. His communication, professionalism, and attention to detail were outstanding, and the finished product exceeded our expectations. Jose truly deserves 5 stars!

Our sales experience was a bit bumpier. Tyler, the owner's son, was our salesperson. While he was friendly, he came across as inexperienced and slightly unprofessional at times. A few key items—like tree removal and specific sprinkler details—were initially left out of the contract. When we raised concerns, he asked us to just take his word for it. Although those items were eventually added, the wording in the contract was vague and left open to interpretation, which caused some confusion down the line. We also had some add-ons mid-project that could have been avoided with a more accurate and thorough quote from the beginning.

That said, once the project transitioned to Jose, we felt confident and well taken care of. He kept everything on track, was easy to reach, and delivered a pool we truly love. Overall, we’re really happy with the outcome and especially grateful for Jose’s expert oversight.
reviews.author: Stephanie Myers
